verdict.rationale: Linear is fundamentally an issue tracker with assignment and delegation features (e.g. issues can be assigned to teammates or agents, per linear-docs-54/64/75), and community evidence confirms it's used to 'quickly capture features and bugs' (linear-comm-4). However, the evidence pack is dominated by AI-agent/coding-session features and lacks direct documentation of basic due-date setting or standard task-assignment workflows that are core to this story. missing for 10: explicit documentation of due-date fields, direct engineer-to-teammate assignment UI flow, independent confirmation of due-date functionality.
